title: Pope Leo in Latin America: Papal Politics and Peru
summary: Pope Leo heads to Argentina for the second leg of his South America tour, where he's expected to draw the biggest turnout of his Papacy so far. The pontiff has wrapped up his first visit to Uruguay. Colleen Dulle, Vatican Correspondent at America Magazine and the co-host of the 'Inside the Vatican' podcast, joins us to analyse the significance of his Latin…
